name: ytstats
description: Pilot the ytstats CLI from plain English — pull YouTube channel analytics, transcripts, manage sign-in, switch channels, diagnose failures. Covers 27 commands, the JSON envelope, and interpretation traps.

ytstats.description: The CLI this skill drives. Run via npx without installing, or installed globally for faster startup. 0.8.1 or newer is required. 0.8.0 added the --segment flag this skill routes to, but on 0.8.0 and earlier `retention` returned an EMPTY curve with ok: true and no warning for every video on a channel whose drop-off metrics YouTube refuses -- the refusal arrives as HTTP 200 with zero rows and the metric fallback only recognised explicit errors. An agent on 0.8.0 would tell a user their videos have no retention data when they have years of it, which also silently breaks the transcript-vs-retention analysis this skill exists to support. The 0.7.1 floor before it existed because 0.7.0's `transcript` returned ZERO cues for every video — captions.download hands back a Blob and the body was read as a string, so a working transcript was indistinguishable from a video with no captions (ok: true plus a DATA_EMPTY warning), and 0.7.1 also normalizes trackKind to upper case, which this skill's ASR guidance branches on.

node.description: Node.js 18 or newer. Required to run ytstats, which is pure JS with no native dependencies.

npx.description: Ships with npm. Used to run ytstats without a global install.

jq.description: Used to extract fields from the JSON envelope without loading whole documents into the conversation.
